space: raw model inputs, 20 curated NHANES columns; ADIPOSITY_BAND as the ordinal the model reads (the API also accepts the named levels)

source.path: reconstructed from nhanes_raw/ cycles 2007-2014 (NOT in the repo, F9-17)
source.note: the TRAINING split only. Drift is measured against what the model learned on, not against the whole cohort. This profile cannot be rebuilt by scripts/build_drift_reference.py --verify because the 79 MB raw survey source is not committed; it is rebuilt by build_nhanes_drift_reference.py in the experiments folder.

reweighting.why: unlike the BRFSS profile, this cohort is a natural-prevalence screening population (0.321 in the training years), not a 50/50 balanced sample, so there is nothing to correct back to.
